name: ApolloOne
price: Free Edition; Standard $35.99, Pro $59.99, Max $99.99 one-time; or yearly Standard $14.99 / Pro $23.99
engine: Apple RAW/ImageIO + LibRaw, RawBridge; system video player; ExifTool, MediaInfo
summary: Fast photo viewer and culling tool for photographers that works on folders without imports. Strong on RAW, HDR, metadata, ratings, AF points and batch work; many features are spread over three paid editions.
where_it_wins: Culling: picks, ratings, Focus Score, AI rating, stacks
HDR RAW display and HDR export
Deep EXIF/IPTC/XMP editing, keywords, GPS maps

free.note: Free Edition after 14-day Max trial; Standard $35.99, Pro $59.99, Max $99.99 perpetual, or yearly from $14.99

native_apple_silicon.note: User guide: Apple Silicon (M1) support since 2.9.0; requirements 'Intel x86 and Apple Silicon CPUs'.

no_account_no_tracking.note: no account; privacy label: usage data for analytics, not linked; AI features use Apple Private Cloud Compute

dark_light_setting.note: Dark Mode UI setting and window background colour under Settings > Appearance

languages_20.note: 11: EN, NL, FR, DE, IT, JA, KO, PL, zh-Hans, ES, zh-Hant

folder_browsing.note: no database imports; Folder Browser and Places

thumbnail_grid.note: Contact Sheet; folder grouping with path bars (4.7)

list_view.note: Standard Edition: sortable table with EXIF columns (5.0)

recursive_search.note: toolbar search with ? and * wildcards; Include Subfolders scans all subfolders

regex_search.note: RegEx search on metadata tags (Pro); filenames via wildcards only

network_shares_fast.note: NAS works over SMB; a review reports 5-10 s folder loads over AFP

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC, AVIF (4.3), JPEG XL; WebP view and export

img_psd_exr.note: OpenEXR view/export; PSD not mentioned in store text or user guide

img_animated.note: GIFs listed; animated WebP/PNG not stated

zoom_rotate.note: keyboard zoom, pan, rotate images and videos

slideshow.note: F5; shuffle (Standard), HDR slideshow (Pro), music from Apple Music, record to video (Pro)

slideshow_recursive.note: slideshow runs through all photos and videos of the file scan, which can include subfolders

auto_enhance_view.note: Pro: non-destructive Quick Edit sliders incl. Auto Tone Curve, saved as parameters

file_info_exif.note: ExifTool incl. maker notes; MediaInfo for video

wrong_extension_note.note: Not in the complete user guide (file info, Inspector, formats).

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Video plays in the system player (HUD controller, AirPlay); the user guide names only QuickTime/HEVC MOV, no MKV, WebM or AVI.

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Photo Video Viewer; videos in Contact Sheet

video_skim_arrows.note: ← → step frame by frame; J/K/L shuttle

subtitles_embedded.note: User guide documents only an external SRT file next to the video ('Use SRT Subtitle').

subtitles_external_files.note: SRT with the same name next to the video

audio_track_choice.note: Video options menu: SRT subtitle, frame stepping, export frame; no audio track choice.

playback_speed.note: J/L cycle rewind/fast-forward speeds; no fixed speed setting

control_bar_movable.note: User guide only says the video controller is HUD-style; whether it stays where dragged is not stated. Searched user guide, site, FAQ.

playlist.note: Slideshow with shuffle over the file scan; playlists exist only as Apple Music background music.

saved_playlists.note: No video playlists in the user guide (only Apple Music playlists for slideshow music).

pip.note: Video section documents AirPlay, JKL, frame stepping; no Picture in Picture.

music_mode.note: Apple Music playlists only as slideshow background music

streaming_urls.note: Image URLs can be dragged in and are downloaded; no video streams or URL playback.

online_subtitles.note: Only a local SRT next to the video.

video_filters_enhance.note: Filters and adjustments are described for images; videos can be rotated/flipped.

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: separate paid app Camera RawX adds Quick Look for RAW/Quick Edits, not for MKV

archives_as_folders.note: the 6,400-line user guide never mentions archives

manga_two_page.note: Split View is a two-image compare view; no comic/RTL reading mode in the user guide.

move_copy.note: Copy To / Move To, drag-and-drop folder moves

dual_pane.note: Split View compares two images, not two folders

undo_file_actions.note: Undo Move to Trash while the app runs; Put Back via optional user script

library_catalog.note: ratings, picks, colour labels, keywords, IPTC/XMP written to files; no import database

keyboard_first.note: culling, rating, video and slideshow all by keys

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: 'All Shortcut Keys' section in the PDF user guide

boss_key.note: Not in the user guide's menus and shortcut keys.

app_sandbox.note: Mac App Store; guide cites App Store sandboxing limits

no_network.note: analytics, Google Maps/Street View, Private Cloud Compute AI

notarized_attested.note: Apple-signed via the App Store; closed source
